19/S0.subgoal: Explain the essential role of VR software in generating an immersive experience.

19/S1.subgoal: Describe the data flow between the user and the VR system and identify the necessary software components.

19/S2.subgoal: Identify and describe the three core activities involved in creating a VR experience.

19/S3.subgoal: Contrast the ideal development process with the practical realities developers face when building VR applications.

19/S4.subgoal: Explain the Virtual World Generator (VWG) abstraction and its critical role in maintaining internal reality.

19/S5.subgoal: Describe the requirements for virtual world generation, including synthetic, recorded, and texture mapping techniques.

19/S6.subgoal: Analyze the concept of matched motion and the challenges developers face when syncing real and virtual movement.

19/S7.subgoal: Describe methods and considerations for implementing user locomotion while minimizing cyber sickness.

19/S8.subgoal: Summarize the key components and ideas of VR software discussed in the lecture.
